title: AcceptanceCriterion
description: Extracted from requirement-record.schema.json so it can be referenced standalone (e.g. by task-spec, which points at a criterion it will close). Consumer: ops.mjs criterion/evidence commands; requirement-record.schema.json $refs this file.

relevantPaths.description: Git pathspecs this criterion's evidence is actually about. When set, gate-engine.mjs's criteria-fresh-evidence check treats evidence as fresh if none of these paths changed since the evidence's recorded head (lib/hash.mjs pathsChangedSince), not only on exact whole-workspace fingerprint equality -- so an unrelated commit elsewhere doesn't stale it. Absent (the default) preserves the strict, unscoped, whole-fingerprint behavior. Set via `ops.mjs criterion set-paths` -- an explicit, reviewed decision, never inferred.

verifiedSinceHead.description: Explicit override of each linked evidence's own recorded `head` when checking scoped freshness -- set via `ops.mjs criterion set-paths --verified-since <commit> --verified-since-reason "..."`. Use only when an evidence's literal recording-time HEAD is provably not the right anchor (e.g. evidence recorded against a long-lived uncommitted working tree later captured by a different batch commit -- see .claude/runtime/backfill-evidence-head.mjs). Always paired with relevantPathsReason/verifiedSinceReason explaining why; never inferred silently.
